Multi-Generational Travel Harmonizer 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Introduces a descriptive skill providing frameworks and analysis for planning multi-generational travel.

- Delivers structured, actionable recommendations and planning templates based on user input.
- Does not execute code, perform bookings, or access real-time data; provides information only.
